IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.ztmp_REQPO_IDs')IS NOT NULL 
DROP TABLE [dbo].[ztmp_REQPO_IDs]; 
CREATE TABLE dbo.ztmp_REQPO_IDs(
RECID bigint NOT NULL,
PARTITION bigint NOT NULL,
DATAAREAID nvarchar(4) NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO dbo.ztmp_REQPO_NoMatch_Distinct
(RECID,PARTITION,DATAAREAID)
SELECT DISTINCT
RECID,PARTITION,DATAAREAID
FROM dbo.ztmp_REQPO_NoMatch

DELETE ax.REQPO FROM ax.REQPO
INNER JOIN dbo.ztmp_REQPO_NoMatch_Distinct
ON REQPO.RECID = dbo.ztmp_REQPO_NoMatch_Distinct.RECID
